Pins the gateway to v0.41.0: the working-set check from #126 (`working_set` on the grant, `capability.InsideWorkingSet`, `fields` on `/v1/policy` and `/v1/agents`).

The sha256 of `control-gateway-linux-amd64` was checked against the release's `SHA256SUMS`: `69ecd72cc09479b369c2f53df00618c49caa919021742640eb1b5c3b2903f5fb`.

After the upgrade, Elixir sees `fields: ["working_set"]` and signs the narrowing that sets `working_set` on both workbench hands. From then on, a passkey capability must carry the working set.
